text_en: Why is a firm willing to enter the classroom at all? What exactly is its incentive?
text_cn: 企业为什么愿意进课堂？它的 incentive 到底是什么？

text_en: What is a firm's incentive for offering "real projects"? How does the return differ from other models?
text_cn: 企业给"真实项目"的 incentive 是什么？回报和别的模式有何不同？

text_en: Why does a firm hire interns? (To screen talent? To build a presence at a prestigious school? — note: 子2's "15-year payer who never hires" falsifies "screening talent" as the only incentive)
text_cn: 企业为什么招实习生？（筛选人才？名校混脸熟？——注意：子2「15 年付费从不招人」已证伪「筛选人才」不是唯一 incentive）

text_en: Which year-level of interns does a firm prefer, and why? (Final-year: mature + more capable + convertible to full-time next year)
text_cn: 企业更喜欢大几的实习生，为什么？（大四：成熟+会得多+明年能转正）

text_en: Why is the firm's annual attrition rate as high as 70–80%?
text_cn: 企业年流失率 70–80% 为什么这么高？

text_en: Can a pre-course mobilization meeting cut attrition to 60%? (Hypothesis, to be tested)
text_cn: 课前动员会能把流失率降到 60% 吗？（假说，待验证）

text_en: Where exactly does co-op's "insufficient firm incentive" (flagged by the Em & Khampirat 2026 review) get stuck, and how is it resolved?
text_cn: COOP 的"企业激励不足"（Em & Khampirat 2026 综述点名）到底卡在哪、怎么解？

text_en: When a firm runs a competition/hackathon, does it want "immediate output" or "future talent"? (branding + talent joint activity)
text_cn: 企业办比赛/黑客松要的是"当下产出"还是"未来人才"？（branding+talent joint activity）

text_en: What is a firm seizing when it spends heavily building a star course? (Scarce top-tier talent)
text_cn: 企业砸重金建明星课，抢的是什么？（稀缺顶尖人才）

text_en: What kind of firm is suited to long-term classroom presence? (Multi-product B2C firms like Li-Ning / Anta vs. giants like Tencent who won't engage)
text_cn: 什么样的企业适合长期进课堂？（多产品 to-C 公司如李宁/安踏 vs 超级巨头腾讯不搭理你）

text_en: The cost of a firm's "try-before-you-buy" (term source: Coco 2000 title) — mentoring input and resource commitment (Hardie, Almeida & Ross 2018) — who bears it?
text_cn: 企业"先试后买"（术语出处：Coco 2000 篇名）的成本——带教投入与资源承诺（Hardie, Almeida & Ross 2018）——谁承担？

text_en: Can fake firms / retired open-source projects substitute for real firms at resource-poor schools?
text_cn: 假企业 / 被淘汰的开源课题，能不能替代真企业给资源缺的学校用？

text_en: What are the preconditions for a firm to partner with a school at all (how does school strength flip "who is more eager")?
text_cn: 企业愿意对接学校的前提条件是什么（学校强弱如何翻转"谁更着急"）？

text_en: A firm's "value perception" and "value itself" are two different things — how do we reconcile them?
text_cn: 企业端"value perceive"和"value 本身"是两件事，怎么统一？

label: 新①
text_en: Once a firm's incentives are already aligned, where does the collaboration's *efficiency* get stuck? Is the firm-side efficiency loss (matching, friction, time) a variable independent of incentive?
text_cn: 企业 incentive 已经对齐之后，合作的效率卡在哪一步？企业端的效率损失（对接、磨合、时间）是不是一个独立于 incentive 的变量？

label: 新②
text_en: Can a firm's "long-term collaboration intent" be quantified? Among application count / renewal rate / mentoring input, which signal is most truthful?
text_cn: 企业"长期合作意愿"能不能被量化？用申请数 / 续约率 / 带教投入，哪个信号最真实？

label: 新③
text_en: Who, inside the firm, attributes and defends the "value of participation" (the mobilization-meeting instructor / HR / alumni / former interns / the liaison themselves)? Is that account constructed ex ante, or ex post to justify renewal?
text_cn: 企业内部的"参与价值"由谁来归因和辩护（动员会老师 / HR / 校友 / 曾经的实习生 / 对接人本人）？这套说法是事前就有，还是事后为了续约而被构造出来的？
misc_tags: "Internships: A try before you buy arrangement" SAM 65(2), 41–43 (end page 43 per CMU catalog; some bibliographies list 41–47 — verify against print TOC)

label: 新④
text_en: What are the components of a firm's transaction costs for one university collaboration (search / contracting / mentoring / monitoring / exit)? Which is largest, and why?
text_cn: 企业参与一次校企合作的"交易成本"由哪几部分构成（搜寻/签约/带教/监督/退出）？哪一部分最大，为什么？
misc_tags: ⚠ weak anchor: that paper studies firms' resource input and mentoring from the *intern's* perspective, not the firm's transaction-cost structure

label: 新⑤
text_en: When a firm partners with multiple schools at once, are marginal costs decreasing (templatable/replicable) or increasing (re-negotiating and re-matching each school)? What variable determines the direction?
text_cn: 一家企业同时对接多所学校时，边际成本是递减（模板化可复制）还是递增（每校重谈重磨合）？什么变量决定方向？

label: 新⑥
text_en: After a firm participates, which of its own metrics changed (new-hire quality / recruiting cost / innovation output / internal technical solutions)? Does the firm itself measure these — and can it?
text_cn: 企业参与后，它自己的哪个指标发生了变化（新员工质量 / 招聘成本 / 创新产出 / 内部技术方案）？这些指标企业自己测不测、测得到吗？

label: 新⑦
text_en: When a firm doesn't return in year 2, is it really "no value", or "value existed but got crowded out" (budget / staffing / liaison turnover)? How to tell the difference?
text_cn: 企业第二年不来，是真的"没价值"，还是"价值有但被挤掉了"（预算/人事/换对接人）？怎么区分？

label: 新⑧
text_en: Jason says value only shows after 2–3 years — is that his personal experience (an outlier), or a replicable regularity? How does the *time structure* of value realization vary by firm type and collaboration model?
text_cn: Jason 说价值 2-3 年后才显现——这是他个人经历（outlier），还是可复制的一般规律？价值显现的**时间结构**会随企业类型、合作模式怎么变？

label: 新⑩
text_en: "Renewing firms report gaining value after 2–3 years" — is this a real learning/screening effect, or **survivorship bias** (firms that gained nothing already exited; the ones left were always the ones that gained)? What design separates the two?
text_cn: "续约企业报告 2-3 年后获得价值"——这是真实的学习/筛选效应，还是**幸存者偏差**（没得到价值的企业早已退出，剩下的本就是得到价值那批）？用什么设计能把两者分开？

label: 新⑨
text_en: Is the reason a firm leaves in year 1 the same as in years 2–3? (Year 1 = expectation mismatch; years 2–3 = value never materialized)
text_cn: 企业第 1 年流失 vs 第 2-3 年流失，原因一样吗？（第 1 年=预期不匹配，第 2-3 年=价值没兑现）

label: 14a
text_en: Which firm type needs a long cycle (observing a student 2–3 months before judging), and which only needs a short one (immediate output / brand exposure)? Is there a stable matching between firm type and time scale?
text_cn: 哪种企业需要长周期（观察学生 2-3 个月才敢下判断）、哪种只要短周期（当下产出/品牌曝光）？企业类型和时间尺度之间有没有稳定的匹配关系？
misc_tags: H5 six incentive types × time scale

label: 14c
text_en: Is a firm's willingness to keep investing in a collaboration **inverse-U shaped** against collaboration length — too short to form a reliable judgment, too long and the willingness decays once the student is fully read? Does this "just-right" point really exist, or is it monotonically decreasing (longer always → less willing)?
text_cn: 企业的继续投入意愿对合作时长，是不是**倒 U 形**——太短形不成可靠判断，太长把学生看清楚之后意愿反而衰减？这个"刚刚好"的点真实存在吗，还是单调递减（越长越不想投）？
source_rec: Dr. Li's core questions: semester vs. summer

label: ①
text_en: Does the premise that a student's short-term labor is "≈ zero value" to the firm actually hold? Kemp, using social exchange theory, says students do bring organizational value, and the benefit exceeds the mentoring cost. Is the firm's incentive for participating "observing future talent", or does it also include "using student output now"? When do the two conflict?
text_cn: 学生短期劳动对企业"≈0 价值"这个前提到底成不成立？Kemp 用社会交换理论说学生能给组织带来价值、收益还大于带教成本。企业参与的 incentive 究竟是"观察未来人才"，还是也包括"当下就用学生产出"？两者什么时候打架？
misc_tags: , Advances in Health Sciences Education 26(3), 1075–1093, DOI

label: ②
text_en: Beyond screening talent, a firm hires interns also to "share training costs". Are "sharing costs" and "screening talent" two sides of the same coin, or two motives that can conflict? When a firm holds several motives at once, which one actually decides whether it renews?
text_cn: 企业招实习生，除了筛选人才，还有"分摊培训成本"这个动机。"分摊成本"和"筛选人才"是同一件事的两面，还是两个会打架的动机？一家企业同时揣着几个动机时，最后是哪个在决定它续不续约？
misc_tags: Em & Khampirat 2026 review flags shared training costs as a co-op benefit
screening vs shared-training-cost conflict / renewal decision not directly adjudicated by the review

label: ③
text_en: A firm spends no cash — just "judge rights + offer rights" — and 86% of students flock to it. How far can this kind of "non-cash incentive" substitute for cash? Is there a point cash can't substitute?
text_cn: 企业不花现金，光靠"评委权 + offer 权"就能让 86% 的学生趋之若鹜。这种"非现金激励"能替代现金到什么程度？有没有一个点是现金替代不了的？

label: ④
text_en: Firms that sponsor competitions expecting to "hire on the spot" are usually disappointed; returns are all tied to long-term recruiting. What determines whether a firm "can afford to wait for long-term returns"? What short-sighted moves does a firm that can't wait make?
text_cn: 赞助竞赛的企业，指望"当场招满人"的往往失望，回报都绑在长期招聘上。企业"能不能等得起长期回报"由什么决定？等不起的企业会做出什么短视动作？
misc_tags: WKU national sales competition ROI, Journal of Selling
17 returns positive but tied to long-term

label: ⑤
text_en: Is it the firm that "wants" talent, or the school that "has to" seek firms after government funding declines? Which end is the true source of demand — and could that decide the entire direction of mechanism design?
text_cn: 企业进课堂，到底是企业"想要"人才，还是学校在政府拨款下降之后"不得不"去找企业？需求的真正源头在哪一端，会不会反过来决定整个机制设计的方向？

label: ⑥
text_en: "The firm" is an abstraction — the actual collaborator is a specific person: HR, a technical lead, or an alumnus. Is this person's individual incentive (recruiting KPI / solving a technical problem / giving back to the alma mater) the same as the firm's incentive? What happens when they diverge?
text_cn: 企业是抽象的，来合作的其实是企业里具体的某个人——HR、技术负责人、还是校友。这个人的个人 incentive（招聘 KPI / 解决技术难题 / 回馈母校），跟企业的 incentive 是一回事吗？两者不一致时，合作会发生什么？

label: ⑦
text_en: Firms treat internships as a "retention" investment — cultivating people who understand their culture, expecting them to stay after graduation; but students treat internships as a "stepping stone" and leave on graduation. In which collaboration form can this "retention" incentive actually be realized? In first/second-year teaching collaborations "retention" doesn't hold at all — what does the firm want there?
text_cn: 企业把实习当"留人"投资——培养理解自己文化的人、指望毕业留下；可学生把实习当"跳板"，毕业就跑。这个"留人" incentive，在哪种合作形式里才可能兑现？大一大二的教学合作里"留人"根本不成立，企业图的是什么？

label: ⑧
text_en: The literature's first remedy for firm attrition is "government incentives" — tax breaks, employer branding, integrity/CSR certification. What is the relationship between these external incentives and the firm's intrinsic motive of "screening talent"? Could external incentives actually crowd out the intrinsic motive?
text_cn: 文献给企业流失开的药方第一条是"政府激励"——减税、雇主品牌、诚信/社会责任认证。政府给的这些外部激励，跟企业"筛选人才"这个内生动机是什么关系？外部激励会不会反而把内生动机挤掉？

label: ⑨
text_en: A firm is "not in a hurry" in internships but "very much in a hurry" in star courses — is this flip the same firm varying by collaboration model, or are "eager firms" and "non-eager firms" two different populations to begin with?
text_cn: 企业在实习里"不着急"、在明星课里"特别着急"——这个"着急"的翻转，是同一家企业随合作模式变，还是"着急的企业"和"不着急的企业"本来就是两拨不同的人？

label: ⑩
text_en: Firm participation rests on "exchange" — what's given and what's received must balance, and imbalance triggers exit. How does the firm weigh this? What degree of "unrealized benefit" triggers exit?
text_cn: 企业参与是基于"交换"——给出去的和得到的要平衡，失衡就退出。企业心里这杆秤怎么称的？什么程度的"收益没兑现"会触发它退出？

label: ⑪
text_en: Inside a firm, does a university collaboration hang on a specific *person*, or on a specific *budget item / post / KPI*? When the liaison changes, does a person-attached collaboration break, while a budget/post-attached one survives the person?
text_cn: 校企合作在企业内部，是挂在某个人身上，还是挂在某个预算科目 / 岗位 / KPI 身上？换对接人的时候，挂在人身上的合作是不是就断了、挂在预算/岗位上的就不随人走？
misc_tags: , (31), 29–34 (note: the journal name was once mis-recorded locally as "Zhejiang Forum")

label: 子1
text_en: A firm "triages" projects into class-2 (genuinely cares but lacks resources to push forward) and hands them to students — what decides the boundary between this and outsourcing / cutting outright? Who inside the firm does the triage?
text_cn: 企业把项目"分诊"成 class-2（真 care 但没资源推进）交给学生，与外包/直接砍掉之间，边界由什么决定？谁在企业内部做这个分诊？

label: 子2
text_en: A firm pays $60k/year for 15 years to sponsor a capstone, has almost never hired from it, yet keeps coming — what exactly is it buying? For a "long-term payer who never hires", does the incentive fall outside recruiting (staff development / CSR / network)?
text_cn: 一家企业 15 年每年掏 6 万美元赞助 capstone、几乎没招到学生、却持续来——它买的到底是什么？"长期付费却不招人"的企业，incentive 是不是落在招聘之外（员工发展 / CSR / 关系网络）？

label: 子3
text_en: Is "try-before-you-buy" reversed between SMEs and large firms: SMEs are even less able to hire (should screen more) but even less able to wait (higher discount rate) — how is that tension resolved?
text_cn: 中小企业 vs 大企业的"先试后买"是否方向相反：中小企业更招不到人（更该筛）但更等不起（贴现率高），这个张力怎么化解？
misc_tags: research gap: SME vs large-firm try-before-you-buy tension

label: 子4
text_en: Is a firm entering the classroom "screening ready-made talent" or "shaping future talent specifications"? When it writes competency standards into course outcomes (68%), is it buying "selecting people" or "defining what qualifies" — are these two incentives the same or different?
text_cn: 企业进课堂是"筛选现成人才"还是"塑造未来人才规格"？当它把胜任力标准写进课程 outcome（68%），它买的是"挑人"还是"定义合格"——这两个 incentive 是同一个还是两回事？

label: 子5
text_en: Is the temporal mismatch between a firm's decision cycle (liaison tenure / budget year) and the student-training cycle (2–4 years) a more fundamental explanation of attrition than "insufficient incentives"?
text_cn: 企业决策周期（对接人任期/预算年度）vs 学生培养周期（2-4 年）的时间错配，是否比"激励不足"更根本地解释流失？

label: 子6
text_en: Is the signal a firm observes in "try-before-you-buy" actually "ability", or "attitude / cultural fit / discipline"? If it is observing trainability and willingness to work overtime (not ability), where is the boundary of screening theory (Stigler/Spence)?
text_cn: 企业"先试后买"观察到的信号，到底是"能力"还是"态度 / 文化契合 / 纪律"？如果它观察的是可塑性、加班意愿（而非能力），筛选理论（Stigler/Spence）的适用边界在哪？
misc_tags: , JPE 70(5-2), 94–105 "Information in the Labor Market" (locally once mislabeled "monograph")
the "students unwilling to work overtime" factor

label: 子7
text_en: Does the internal budget-item attribution of the collaboration (recruiting vs. brand vs. CSR vs. staff development) decide its survival — recorded under "recruiting" it carries a hard KPI, under "CSR" it's the first to be cut?
text_cn: 企业内部的预算科目归属（招聘 vs 品牌 vs CSR vs 员工发展），是不是决定了合作存续——记在"招聘"下就有硬 KPI、记在"CSR"下就被优先砍？

label: 子8
text_en: When an alumnus serves as the liaison, the firm's incentive slides from "organizational interest" to "personal alma mater sentiment" — does this make the collaboration more fragile (breaks when the alumnus leaves) or more durable (emotional bond resists budget pressure)?
text_cn: 校友身份当对接人，让企业激励从"组织利益"滑向"个人母校情结"——这使合作更脆弱（校友一走即断）还是更稳固（情感绑定抗拒预算压力）？

label: 研①
text_en: After AI can handle entry-level / codifiable tasks, does a firm entering the classroom want "to screen out people AI will replace" or "to find people who can use AI"? How much has AI rewritten the firm's incentive for entering the classroom (screening talent / seeking ideas)?
text_cn: AI 能完成初级/可编码任务之后，企业进课堂要的到底是「筛掉会被 AI 替代的人」，还是「找会用 AI 的人」？企业进课堂的 incentive（筛人才/要点子）被 AI 改写了多少？

text_en: Why is the school short of money? (Only national teaching funding, once a year)
text_cn: 学校为什么没钱？（只能靠国家教学经费，一年一次）

text_en: What is the institution's incentive? (reputation/risk)
text_cn: 学校的 incentive 是什么？（声誉/风险）

text_en: How does an ordinary university connect to firms willing to collaborate long-term? (Strong schools can run star courses — what about ordinary ones?)
text_cn: 普通高校怎么对接到愿意长期合作的企业？（强校能开明星课，普通校呢）

text_en: How does the institution avoid being captured by firms (preserving autonomy, keeping students from becoming free labor)? (Zukin & Papadantonakis 2017, Research in the Sociology of Work 31, 157–181 · co-optation ritual)
text_cn: 学校怎么避免被企业捕获（保住院校自主、学生不被当免费劳动力）？（Zukin & Papadantonakis 2017, Research in the Sociology of Work 31, 157-181 · co-optation ritual）

text_en: Why is the institutional system "locked at the compliance layer" (rules exist but no governance)?
text_cn: 院系制度为什么"锁定在合规层"（有制度却无治理）？

text_en: What do the governance differences across the four schools (HKU / CUHK / HKUST / PolyU) reveal?
text_cn: 四校（港大/港中大/港科/港理工）的治理差异暴露了什么？

text_en: Who decides whether a collaboration "succeeded"? School / student / instructor / firm use different yardsticks.
text_cn: 校企合作的"成功"谁说了算？学校/学生/老师/企业的标准不一样。

text_en: Will a firm return next year after a one-off successful course? One-off = the instructor scrambles half a year in advance every semester.
text_cn: 一次性成功的课，明年企业还回来吗？一次性 = 每学期老师提前半年折腾。

label: 新①
text_en: The institution is "locked at the compliance layer" — rules exist (0-credit internships, accreditation requirements) but no governance (no one manages firm attrition). Why doesn't the institution dare move from "compliance" to "governance"? What is blocking it?

text_en: In star courses the firm is "too eager" — what does the institution rely on to keep autonomy? The literature (Slaughter/Zukin) only sounds alarms and gives no classroom-level mechanism — so where does the institution's "anti-capture" counterforce actually come from?
text_cn: 明星课里企业"太着急"，院系靠什么保住自主？文献（Slaughter/Zukin）只敲警钟、没给课堂级机制——那院系"防捕获"的反制力到底来自哪？

text_en: From the institution's KE policy as "strategic slogan" to "instructor behavior", what transmission links lie in between (promotion weight / performance / funding / dean pressure)? At which link is the chain most likely to break?
text_cn: 院系的 KE 政策从「战略口号」到「教师行为」，中间经过哪些传导环节（晋升权重/绩效/经费/院长压力）？在哪一环最可能断？

label: 研②
text_en: UGC's KE metric is "knowledge-transfer income" (research commercialization), not "education-side enterprise collaboration". Is the policy signal itself skewed — it rewards research monetization but does not assess "firms teaching in the classroom"? Is this metric skew the upstream source of "the institution's urgency not reaching education"?
text_cn: UGC 的 KE 考核口径是「知识转移收入」（科研商业化），不是「教育端校企合作」。政策信号本身是否就偏了——它激励科研变现，却不考核「企业进课堂教学生」？这个口径偏差，是否就是「院系 urgency 传导不到教育端」的源头？
misc_tags: UGC KT metric vs. education side

label: 治①
text_en: How are the five parties' (Instructor / TA / Student / Enterprise / Institution) incentives aligned to pull in one direction?
text_cn: 五方（老师/助教/学生/企业/院系）的 incentive 怎么对齐、往一处使？

label: 治②
text_en: Who pays whom (funding heterogeneity: South Africa unfunded vs. Ireland subsidized)
text_cn: 钱谁给谁（funding 异构：南非无资助 vs 爱尔兰有补贴）

label: 治③
text_en: Who controls assessment (firms writing 68% of outcomes = the extreme form)
text_cn: 考核谁说了算（企业写 outcome 68% = 极端形态）

label: 治④
text_en: What does the student produce that counts as "the real thing" (not homework)
text_cn: 学生做出什么才算"真东西"（不是作业）

label: 治⑤
text_en: What is each stakeholder's actual "currency" under different models (money vs. signal vs. reputation)?
text_cn: 每个 stakeholder 在不同模式下真正在乎的"货币"是什么（钱 vs 信号 vs 声誉）？

label: 治⑥
text_en: How to give each stakeholder "the attribute it lacks" (firm lacks urgency / student lacks power)?
text_cn: 怎么给每个 stakeholder "补它缺的属性"（企业缺 urgency / 学生缺 power）？

label: 治⑦
text_en: How is value creation defined, and value capture realized — "the wool comes off the pig's back" (i.e., the bill is footed by a third party, not by the one who produces the value)?
text_cn: 价值 creation 怎么定义、价值 capture 怎么实现（"羊毛出在猪身上"）？

label: 治⑧
text_en: Governance is two-way: invite in (firm too cold) + guard against capture (firm too hot) — how does one mechanism stay stable at both ends?
text_cn: 治理是双向的：请进来（企业过冷）+ 防捕获（企业过热），同一机制怎么两端都稳？

label: 治⑨
text_en: Why has the mechanism-design lens never shone on *teaching* collaborations that bring enterprises into the classroom? (= the gap itself)
text_cn: 机制设计镜头为什么从没照过"企业进课堂"的教学合作？（= gap 本身）

label: 治⑪
text_en: Who is "least able to walk away" from this collaboration (elasticity / tax incidence)? The party with lower elasticity bears more of the cost.
text_cn: 谁最"离不开"这次合作（弹性/税负归宿）？谁弹性低谁多承担成本。

label: 治⑫
text_en: How is "try-before-you-buy" (term source Coco 2000; mechanism = screening Stigler 1962 / signaling Spence 1973) translated into a course mechanism?
text_cn: "先试后买"（术语源 Coco 2000；机制=筛选 Stigler 1962 / 信号 Spence 1973）怎么翻译成课程机制？

label: 治⑬
text_en: How is stakeholder salience (power / legitimacy / urgency) quantified across the five parties?
text_cn: stakeholder salience（power/legitimacy/urgency）怎么量化到五方？

label: 治⑭
text_en: Instrumentation: how is the planning / management / enhancement of enterprise-engaged courses automated?
text_cn: 工具化：校企合作课程的 planning / management / enhancement 怎么自动化？

label: 研③
text_en: AI may for the first time quantify "relationship maintenance / tacit labor" — but once a metric is used for decisions it corrupts (Campbell's Law). Does "AI quantifying tacit labor" make enterprise collaboration measurable (slowing its marginalization), or does it manufacture a more easily manipulated metric?
text_cn: AI 第一次可能把「关系维护/隐性劳动」量化出来——但指标一旦被用于决策就会腐化（Campbell's Law）。「AI 量化隐性劳动」到底让校企合作从不可测变可测（减缓边缘化），还是制造一个更容易被操纵的指标？

label: 研④
text_en: A firm's ROI on enterprise collaboration is negative in the first two years (Swiss apprenticeship: −20% / −5%), turning positive only in years 3–4. Who bears / subsidizes this "loss period"? If nobody subsidizes it, why should a firm renew before ROI turns positive?
text_cn: 企业参与校企合作前两年 ROI 为负（瑞士学徒：−20% / −5%），第 3-4 年才转正。谁承担/补贴这个「亏损期」？如果没人补贴，企业为什么该在 ROI 转正前续约？

label: 研⑤
text_en: In Canada's SWPP, 76% of firms "would not have hired a student" without the subsidy. Is the subsidy a "starter" or a "permanent crutch"? Once the subsidy exits, what intrinsic incentive keeps the firm?
text_cn: 加拿大 SWPP 里 76% 的企业「本不会雇学生」，靠补贴才进场。补贴是「启动器」还是「永久拐杖」？补贴退出后，企业靠什么内在 incentive 留下来？
misc_tags: SWPP 24% would hire without subsidy ictc-ctic

label: 研⑥
text_en: Of the value enterprise collaboration produces (students learning + firms gaining productivity + schools gaining reputation), who is the residual claimant? If no party is accountable for "whether value actually materializes", why should it persist?
text_cn: 校企合作产生的价值（学生学到东西 + 企业拿到生产力 + 学校拿到声誉），谁是这个价值的剩余索取者（residual claimant）？如果没有任何一方对「价值是否真实产生」负责，价值为什么应该持续？

label: 研⑦
text_en: When "the wool comes off the pig's back" (value capture is footed by a third party, not by the party producing the value), who has the incentive to maximize the value itself? Is this the economic root of "one-off-ness"?
text_cn: 当「羊毛出在猪身上」（value capture 由第三方买单，而非产生价值的一方）时，谁有 incentive 去最大化价值本身？这是否就是「一次性」的经济学根源？

text_en: Why is the instructor willing to bridge? (incentive = promotion?)
text_cn: 老师为什么愿意搭桥（incentive = 评职称？）

text_en: How does the "promotion" incentive get wired into mechanism design?
text_cn: 评职称这个 incentive 怎么接进机制设计？

text_en: PBL can't be done by one instructor — who pays the extra instructors (external experts)?
text_cn: PBL 一个老师做不起来，额外老师（外请专家）的工资谁出？

text_en: Instructors lack entrepreneurship/industry experience — how to fill it? (joint teaching with industry experts, Wu & Chen)
text_cn: 老师缺创业/产业经验，怎么补？（企业专家联合授课 Wu & Chen）

text_en: How is the role "instructor = knowledge broker" theorized?
text_cn: "教师=知识经纪人 knowledge broker"这个角色怎么理论化？
misc_tags: Knight 2024 knowledge broker concept, sourced to teacher-educator context
industry-facing instructor application not yet theorized

text_en: Instructors get a new batch of students every year but don't themselves change — how to keep teaching quality from slipping?
text_cn: 老师每年换一批学生，他自己不换，怎么保持教学质量不滑坡？

text_en: Does the instructor bear responsibility for firm attrition? Who is accountable for retention?
text_cn: 老师要不要担"企业流失"的责任？谁对留存负责？

label: 新①
text_en: The instructor's bridging incentive is promotion, but does "enterprise-in-the-classroom" actually count in promotion review? If promotion doesn't recognize it at all, what keeps the instructor going?
text_cn: 老师搭桥的 incentive 是评职称，但"企业进课堂"在职称评价里到底算不算数？如果评职称根本不认这个，老师靠什么撑下去？

label: 新②
text_en: Instructors lack industry experience, and the literature's remedy is "bringing in industry experts to co-teach". Between "the instructor gaining experience themselves" and "bringing in experts", which is cheaper and which is sustainable? Which will the instructor choose?
text_cn: 老师缺产业经验，文献给的办法是"引进企业专家联合授课"。"老师自己补经验"和"引进专家"相比，哪个成本低、哪个可持续？老师会选哪条？
misc_tags: , Course Design for College Entrepreneurship Education, Frontiers in Psychology 10, 1016

label: 研①
text_en: AI makes research output (papers / code / experiments) faster and more measurable — does it accelerate the crowding-out of the unmeasurable "enterprise collaboration" anchor by the measurable "research" anchor (Holmström multi-task)? Where does instructor time flow even more in the AI age?
text_cn: AI 让科研产出（论文/代码/实验）更快更可测，是否加速了「科研」这根可测锚对「校企合作」这根不可测锚的挤出（Holmström 多任务）？AI 时代教师的时间更往哪流？

label: 研②
text_en: Besides promotion, what other incentives drive the instructor to bridge (intrinsic motivation / peer recognition / funding / time cost / academic reputation)? What are their relative weights? What method (revealed preference / conjoint) extracts true weights rather than self-reported ones?
text_cn: 教师 bridge 的激励，除评职称外还有哪些（内在动机/同伴认可/经费/时间成本/学术声誉）？各占多少权重？用什么方法（revealed preference / conjoint）逼出真实权重，而非自报权重？

label: 研③
text_en: Between "measurable incentives" (promotion) and "unmeasurable incentives" (intrinsic motivation / peer recognition), which dominates the instructor's decision to do enterprise collaboration? Do the weights differ between business (promotion-sensitive) and engineering (personal-feel-sensitive) disciplines?
text_cn: 「可测量激励」（评职称）与「不可测量激励」（内在动机/同伴认可），在教师决定是否做校企合作时谁占主导？商科（对晋升敏感）与工科（对个人感受敏感）的权重是否不同？

label: 课①
text_en: For university-industry co-teaching PBL, does a long cycle (semester) or a short cycle (summer, 2–3 weeks) fit?
text_cn: 校企共同做 PBL，适合长周期（semester）还是短周期（summer 2-3 周）？
source_rec: Rec 8/19 Dr. Li — one of the core questions

label: 课②
text_en: What topics to introduce at first/second/third year respectively? (no-threshold → mildly professional → deeply professional → capstone interfacing the workplace)
text_cn: 大一大二大三分别引入什么课题？（无门槛→轻度专业→深度专业→毕设对接职场）

label: 课③
text_en: Why can't a first-year topic be domain-specific (can't do it without calculus/statistics)?
text_cn: 大一课题为什么不能 domain-specific（微积分/统计没学过就不会做）？

label: 课④
text_en: How does the capstone interface "entry-level professional" real projects?
text_cn: 毕业设计怎么对接"职场新人级"真实项目？

label: 课⑤
text_en: How to do a circular topic (smart home → classroom → e-commerce, one cycle every 5 years)?
text_cn: circular topic（smart home→classroom→e-commerce，5 年一圈）怎么做？

label: 课⑥
text_en: In university-industry co-teaching, how to make the student's "homework" valuable to the firm (rather than just homework)?
text_cn: 校企共教怎么让学生的"作业"对企业有价值（而非只是作业）？

label: 课⑦
text_en: How to solve the privacy problem of real projects (firms won't give real data)?
text_cn: 真实项目的隐私问题怎么解（企业不给真数据）？

label: 课⑧
text_en: Hackathons/competitions have no instructor (only results, no education) — what is the course's unique value?
text_cn: 黑客松/比赛没有老师教（只有结果没教育），课的独特价值是什么？

label: 课⑨
text_en: Course "one price" (anyone who pays tuition can attend) vs. internship "screening system" (compete for resources) — where does the scalability difference lie?
text_cn: 课程"一口价"（交了学费人人能上）vs 实习"筛选制"（竞争拿资源），scalability 差在哪？

label: 课⑩
text_en: In grade-level topic design, how does the firm give "broad problems" (a mother-baby company doing "going out" this year / "teething" next year)?
text_cn: 分年级课题设计，企业端的"宽泛问题"（母婴公司今年外出/明年磨牙）怎么给？

text_en: The TA is the "load-bearing wall of grunt work" — what is their incentive/cost, and who manages it?
text_cn: 助教是"杂活承重墙"，他的 incentive/cost 是什么、谁管？

text_en: How is the TA's salience (low power / high urgency) made visible inside the mechanism?
text_cn: 助教的 salience（权力低/紧迫高）怎么在机制里被看见？

label: 新①
text_en: The TA is the one stakeholder entirely absent from the literature. In enterprise-engaged courses, what does the TA actually carry (liaising with firms? supervising students? grading)? Who compensates their cost?
text_cn: 五方里助教是文献完全缺席的一方。校企合作课程里，助教实际扛了什么（对接企业？带学生？改作业？）？他的成本谁补？

label: 新②
text_en: The TA's salience is *demanding* — urgency only, no power, no legitimacy. Is this "most overworked yet least heard" party the first point where enterprise-engaged teaching collapses?
text_cn: 助教的 salience 是 demanding——只有 urgency、没 power 没 legitimacy。"最累但最没话语权"这一方，会不会是校企合作最容易塌的那一环？

text_en: Why do students take loss-making internships (short-term labor ≈ zero value, in exchange for long-term return)?
text_cn: 学生为什么倒贴实习（短期劳动≈0 价值，换长期回报）？

text_en: Can first/second-year students get internships through effort? (Almost not, unless restaurant waiting)
text_cn: 大一大二学生能靠努力找到实习吗？（几乎不能，除非餐厅服务员）

text_en: What students produce is the same every year (repetition = no value) — how to make each year create new value?
text_cn: 学生做的东西每年都一样（重复=无价值），怎么让每年创造新价值？

text_en: What should students learn to avoid being replaced by AI? (= exploratory work)
text_cn: 学生要学什么才不被 AI 取代？（= 探索性工作）

text_en: 86.4% of hackathon students come for "challenge + being seen", not prizes — what is a student's "currency", really?
text_cn: 黑客松学生 86.4% 因"挑战+被看见"而来、非奖品——学生的"货币"到底是什么？

text_en: Motivations and satisfaction differences across project types students choose (community / internal / industry) (ASEE)
text_cn: 学生选项目类型（社区/内部/产业）的动机和满意度差异（ASEE）

text_en: Competition → internship → graduate school, this "pre-graduation talent-locking chain" favors elite-school students — how to fix the fairness?
text_cn: 竞赛→实习→研究生，这条"毕业前人才锁定链"偏袒名校生，公平性怎么破？

text_en: A student who has "only done homework" enters a firm — why can't they solve real problems?
text_cn: 学生"只做过作业"就进企业，为什么解决不了真问题？

text_en: Course vs. competition vs. internship — which is most equal for students (largest scalability)?
text_cn: 课程 vs 竞赛 vs 实习，哪个对学生最平等（scalability 最大）？

label: 新①
text_en: Students "take a loss" (short-term labor for long-term return), but is the "long-term return" the same for different students? Do first-year and final-year students want the same "long-term return"?
text_cn: 学生"倒贴"（短期劳动换长期回报），但"长期回报"对不同学生是不是不一样？大一学生和大四学生要的，是同一个"长期回报"吗？

label: 新②
text_en: The competition → internship → graduate-school "talent-locking chain" favors elite-school students. Where does an ordinary-school student sit inside this mechanism?
text_cn: 竞赛→实习→研究生这条"人才锁定链"偏袒名校生。普通校的学生，在这套机制里处于什么位置？

label: 研①
text_en: Does the student's "long-term return" (signal value / ~20% wage premium) actually materialize? If the signal a student buys with their loss-making labor depreciates in the AI age, will the student — the demand side — exit first?
text_cn: 学生的「长期回报」（信号价值/约 20% 收入溢价）是否真实兑现？如果学生的倒贴换来的信号在 AI 时代贬值，学生这个需求端会不会先退场？

label: EXP-001
text_en: Within a student team, does the firm's preference for final-year interns create a staffing split where lower-year students are kept away from client-facing or decision-making tasks?
text_cn: 一个学生团队里，企业偏好大四生，会不会造成分工分层：低年级学生被排除在客户对接或关键决策之外？
new_angle: 把“偏好大四生”从企业总体偏好落到 team 内部分工与年级资源分配。

label: EXP-002
text_en: When the firm's annual attrition is reported as 70–80%, does that aggregate mask different dropout timings by firm size or sector?
text_cn: 企业年流失率报成 70–80%，这个汇总数字是否掩盖了不同规模、不同行业企业在退场时点上的差异？
new_angle: 把流失率从单一年度数字拆成退场时点问题，不再附带按月/按年监控的设计尾巴。

label: EXP-003
text_en: Does a pre-course mobilization meeting lower firm attrition mainly through the written commitment a firm signs at the meeting, through the information exchanged before any commitment, or through both jointly?
text_cn: 课前动员会降低企业流失，主要靠的是企业在会上签署的书面承诺、签署承诺之前交换的信息，还是两者共同作用？
new_angle: 把动员会效果拆成“书面承诺渠道”和“信息交换渠道”，并保留“两者共同作用”退路；与 EXP-027 互引。

label: EXP-004
text_en: Does a multi-product B2C firm's classroom participation depend more on a marketing budget, a talent-pipeline budget, or a technical-solution budget?
text_cn: 多产品 B2C 企业的课堂参与，更多取决于营销预算、人才管道预算，还是技术方案预算？
new_angle: 把 B2C 企业的课堂参与拆成营销、人才管道、技术方案三种预算投入，不追问验证交付物。

label: EXP-005
text_en: When a resource-poor school substitutes a retired open-source project for a real firm, what, if anything, is lost from the real-firm experience: confidential data, accountability, or the firm mentor's tacit knowledge?
text_cn: 当资源匮乏的学校用退役开源项目替代真实企业时，真实企业体验中究竟失去了什么（如果确有失去）：保密数据、责任约束，还是企业导师的隐性知识？
new_angle: 把“假企业替代”拆成可替换项与不可替换项，并保留“可能什么都没丢”的空选项。

label: EXP-006
text_en: At a strong school, does the firm's eagerness shift from talent acquisition to brand association?
text_cn: 在强校，企业方的积极性会不会从人才获取转向品牌关联？
new_angle: 把“学校强弱翻转谁更着急”进一步拆成动机类型；事前识别信号不再并进题干。

label: EXP-007
text_en: What observable metric would force a firm to update its perceived value of participation: mentor hours, student hire conversions, or project output quality?
text_cn: 企业会从哪个可观察指标来更新它对参与价值的认知：导师投入小时、学生转正率，还是项目产出质量？
new_angle: 把 value perception 与 value itself 的落差变成一个可测量、可更新的指标问题；从候选中剔除续约行为，避免结果变量同时充当信号。

label: EXP-008
text_en: After incentive alignment, does firm-side efficiency loss concentrate in project scoping, mentor scheduling, or feedback turnaround?
text_cn: 在 incentive 对齐之后，企业端效率损失是否集中在课题界定、导师排期，还是反馈响应周期？
new_angle: 把“效率损失独立于 incentive”拆到三个可观察环节；模板干预部分已拆入 `扩题_设计题.md` DES-003。

label: EXP-009
text_en: Which signal of long-term collaboration intent is least gameable by the firm: application count, number of mentors assigned, or pre-course resource commitments?
text_cn: 企业长期合作意愿的哪个信号最不容易被企业操纵：申请数、派出的导师人数，还是开课前做出的资源承诺？
new_angle: 把“量化长期意愿”聚焦为信号排序；剔除续约率，避免循环定义。

label: EXP-010
text_en: When the firm's internal account of participation value is constructed ex post, does renewal differ depending on whether the project-level narrator is the liaison or the mentor?
text_cn: 当企业内部的参与价值说法是事后建构的，项目层叙述者是对接人还是导师，会不会带来不同的续约结果？
new_angle: 把“学校该听谁”改为可检验的续约差异；叙述者识别通道不再并进题干。

label: EXP-011
text_en: When a firm's transaction costs for one university collaboration (search, contracting, mentoring, monitoring, exit) are allocated to a single student project rather than the firm-level program, which cost is most likely to be underestimated relative to its actual share?
text_cn: 企业一次校企合作的交易成本，若被分摊到单个学生项目、而非企业级项目，哪一类最容易被低估，且相对其真实占比被低估得最多？
new_angle: 把交易成本构成问题从总量比较推进到项目级分摊与低估，并给“低估”加上相对真实占比的基准。

label: EXP-012
text_en: When a firm partners with multiple schools, is the turning point between decreasing and increasing marginal cost set by a reusable course template or by school-specific relationship assets?
text_cn: 一家企业同时对接多所学校时，边际成本由递减转为递增的拐点，是由可复用的课程模板决定，还是由各校特有的关系资产决定？
new_angle: 把“边际成本方向”的抽象判断落到模板资产与关系资产的可复制性。

label: EXP-013
text_en: Which of the firm's post-participation metrics can a school actually observe without overclaiming access: new-hire quality, recruiting cost, innovation output, or internal technical solutions?
text_cn: 企业参与后，学校在不越界获取内部数据的前提下，到底能观察到哪个指标：新员工质量、招聘成本、创新产出，还是内部技术方案？
new_angle: 把“企业自己测不测得到”转成学校可合法观察的指标边界。

label: EXP-014
text_en: When a firm does not return in year 2, what school-side data would distinguish “the collaboration had no value” from “value existed but was crowded out by budget, staffing, or liaison turnover”?
text_cn: 企业第二年不来时，学校凭哪些数据能区分“合作本来就没价值”和“有价值但被预算、人事或对接人变动挤掉了”？
new_angle: 把“没价值 vs 被挤掉”落到学校可观测的区分证据。

label: EXP-015
text_en: Does the 2–3-year delay in realized firm value shorten when the same firm runs one continuous project, rather than restarting with a new student team each year?
text_cn: 同一家企业连续做一个项目，而不是每年换新学生团队重开，企业价值 2–3 年才显现的时滞会不会缩短？
new_angle: 把价值显现的时间结构落到项目连续性这一可操作变量。

label: EXP-016
text_en: Is the shift from year-1 expectation mismatch to years-2–3 non-materialization a discrete transition that occurs before the firm's exit, rather than only becoming visible at exit?
text_cn: 企业从“第 1 年预期不匹配”滑向“第 2–3 年价值没兑现”，是不是一个在企业退出前就已发生的阶段性转变，而不是到退出时才显现？
new_angle: 把流失原因分层转成退出前是否可识别的阶段性转变，不附带干预或预警设计。

label: EXP-017
text_en: Is the stable matching between firm type and observation timescale visible in course design choices such as semester length, sprint cadence, or final demo timing?
text_cn: 企业类型与观察时间尺度之间的稳定匹配，能否从学期长度、迭代节奏或最终展示时间这些课程设计选择中看出来？
new_angle: 把抽象的时间尺度匹配落到具体课程设计变量。

label: EXP-018
text_en: If a firm's willingness to keep investing is inverse-U shaped, does mentor meeting frequency decline before, after, or at the same time as total mentor hours as a firm approaches exit?
text_cn: 如果企业的继续投入意愿随合作时长呈倒 U 形，在临近退出时，导师会议频率的下降会先于、晚于，还是与导师总投入小时的减少同步发生？
new_angle: 把倒 U 拐点问题转为退出前两项投入信号的时点比较，并与事后检验题 EXP-080 区分。

label: EXP-019
text_en: When an HR liaison's recruiting KPI diverges from a technical lead's project goal on the same student team, which party controls the team's scope and budget?
text_cn: 同一个学生团队里，HR 对接人的招聘 KPI 和技术负责人的项目目标不一致时，团队范围和预算由谁控制？
new_angle: 把个人与组织 incentive 的分歧落到团队预算和范围控制权，不再追问控制权如何影响续约。

label: EXP-020
text_en: In class-2 project triage, does the firm hand over projects at the moment internal resources become scarce rather than when educational value is highest?
text_cn: 在 class-2 项目的分诊中，企业是在内部资源一紧张就把项目交给学生，还是在教育价值最高时才交出？
new_angle: 把分诊边界从“真 care 但没资源”拆成时间点；内部决策者不再并进题干。

label: EXP-021
text_en: When a sponsoring firm has no immediate hiring quota, does its preference for final-year interns weaken and shift toward lower-year students whose project supervision costs less time?
text_cn: 当赞助企业当期没有直接招聘名额时，它对大四实习生的偏好会不会减弱，并转向带教更省时间的低年级学生？
new_angle: 把“偏好大四生”从固定偏好变成无转正名额时的反事实检验，区分“可转正”与“省时带教”两种动因。

label: EXP-022
text_en: Does a firm's preferred intern year-level change across a semester course, a summer internship, and a year-long project?
text_cn: 企业对实习生的年级偏好，会在学期课程、暑期实习和一年期项目之间发生变化吗？
new_angle: 把年级偏好放到课程、暑期、年长项目三种时间结构中比较，而非团队内部分层。

label: EXP-023
text_en: When a firm prefers final-year interns, can the school use its pre-placement data to identify capable lower-year students who were excluded mainly because of their year-level, or is that counterfactual unobservable?
text_cn: 当企业偏好大四实习生时，学校能否用学生进入企业前已有的数据，识别出那些主要因年级而被排除、但本身有能力的低年级学生？还是说这个反事实根本无法观测？
new_angle: 从企业为何偏好转为学校能否在无企业数据时检验年级排除这一选择偏差。

label: EXP-024
text_en: Is the firm's reported 70–80% annual attrition measuring only formal exit from a project, while firms that downgrade to guest lectures or shadow mentoring remain outside the count?
text_cn: 企业 70–80% 的年流失率，是否只统计了正式退出项目，而那些降级为客座讲座或影子带教的企业反而没被计入？
new_angle: 把流失率的测量边界从退场时点推进到“正式退出 vs 降级参与”的隐藏流失。

label: EXP-025
text_en: If 70–80% of firms leave each year, do the remaining firms represent those that value classroom collaboration most, or those whose exit costs are highest due to prior hires, co-authored projects, or public commitments?
text_cn: 如果每年有 70–80% 的企业退出，留下来的企业究竟是最看重课堂合作的企业，还是因过往录用、共同署名项目或公开承诺而退出成本最高的企业？
new_angle: 从“为什么离开”转向“留下者是谁”，用幸存者退出成本解释留存而非价值排序。

label: EXP-026
text_en: When the school reports 70–80% annual attrition, is the unit being counted the firm or the firm–project contract?
text_cn: 学校报告 70–80% 年流失率时，统计单位到底是企业，还是企业与项目之间的合约？
new_angle: 把 70–80% 的分子分母问题落到统计单位；是否重算留存率不再并进题干。

label: EXP-027
text_en: Does a pre-course mobilization meeting lower firm attrition by changing expectations during the course, by prompting low-commitment firms to withdraw before the course begins, or by both mechanisms?
text_cn: 课前动员会降低企业流失率，是因为它在课程过程中改变企业预期，还是促使低承诺企业在开课前就提前退出，或者两条机制同时存在？
new_angle: 把动员会效果拆成课中预期调整与课前自我筛选两条机制，并保留“两者同时存在”退路；与 EXP-003 互引。

label: EXP-028
text_en: Is the 20-percentage-point attrition reduction driven mainly by first-time firms, while returning firms would have stayed regardless of the meeting?
text_cn: 那 20 个百分点的流失率下降，是否主要由首次合作的企业贡献，而老企业即使没有动员会也会留下？
new_angle: 把 20 个百分点下降按首次/复访企业拆分，检验异质效应而非跨届稳定性。

label: EXP-029
text_en: Does moving the pre-course mobilization meeting online weaken its effect because firms cannot inspect classroom space, equipment, or student logistics?
text_cn: 把课前动员会搬到线上，会不会因为企业无法实地查看教室空间、设备或学生的组织安排而削弱效果？
new_angle: 把动员会效果落到线上化后损失的现场空间信号，而非重复问效果是否持续。

label: EXP-030
text_en: Does a multi-product B2C firm remain in the classroom because it has a consumer brand, or because it can staff a dedicated campus team?
text_cn: 一家多产品 B2C 企业能留在课堂，是因为它有消费者品牌，还是因为它能组建专职的校园团队？
new_angle: 把“什么企业适合”从品牌曝光拆成品牌资源与专职校园团队两个可分离约束。

label: EXP-031
text_en: Does a firm's long-term classroom presence depend on students being its current consumers, future employees, or both?
text_cn: 企业长期留在课堂，是取决于学生是它的现有消费者、未来员工，还是两者兼有？
new_angle: 把企业类型问题从 to-C/to-B 分类转到学生与企业之间“消费者/准员工”关系类型。

label: EXP-032
text_en: When a giant firm refuses to engage, what is the minimum level of its involvement—public data, recorded talks, software tools, or something more—at which a course still counts the arrangement as a firm partnership?
text_cn: 当巨头企业拒绝参与时，课程要把安排算作“校企合作”，最低需要企业做到哪一步——公开数据、录播讲座、软件工具，还是更高程度的参与？
new_angle: 把“巨头不搭理”从无法合作转为校企合作的最低参与门槛问题，不再预设公开数据等替代物。

label: EXP-033
text_en: For resource-poor schools, does a retired open-source project preserve the technical problem but lose the firm's changing requirements?
text_cn: 对资源匮乏的学校来说，退役开源项目能否保留技术问题本身，却丢掉企业不断变化的需求？
new_angle: 把假企业替代从保密、问责、隐性知识中单独抽出“需求动态变化”这一维度，不附带教师注入需求的干预。

label: EXP-034
text_en: When a resource-poor school uses retired open-source projects instead of real firms, does it save partnership money now but shift the cost into students' weaker employer signals later?
text_cn: 资源匮乏的学校用退役开源项目替代真实企业时，是不是现在省下合作经费，却把成本转成学生未来更弱的雇主信号？
new_angle: 把开源替代从即时体验损失转为跨期成本转移，不再追问如何测量取舍。

label: EXP-035
text_en: As real-firm projects are replaced by retired open-source projects, does the signal to prospective students weaken, does the signal to employers weaken, or do neither change?
text_cn: 真实企业项目被退役开源项目替代时，面向潜在学生的信号会减弱、面向雇主的信号会减弱，还是两者都不变？
new_angle: 去掉“至少要维持多高比例”的阈值方案，改为检验真实项目占比下降时信号是否被稀释。

label: EXP-036
text_en: In a firm–school partnership, does the “who is more eager” power reversal occur at the start of the relationship, after the first cohort's outcomes, or only when the school has a star course?
text_cn: 校企合作中，“谁更着急”的权力翻转，发生在合作开始时、首批学生结果出来后，还是只有学校有明星课时？
new_angle: 把强弱翻转放到关系时间线，替代“弱校如何让企业愿意合作”的院系侧问法。

label: EXP-037
text_en: Does the "who is more eager" reversal depend on the organizational level at which the firm and school interact—school brand, course capacity, or a single project's co-located space?
text_cn: “谁更着急”的翻转，是否取决于校企互动的组织层面：学校品牌、课程容量，还是单个项目的同地空间？
new_angle: 把“谁更着急”的翻转落到组织层级与单一强课的局部议价能力，不再追问局部做强是否足以翻转。

label: EXP-038
text_en: Does a firm treat onsite student co-location as a substitute for school reputation, a complement to it, or neither?
text_cn: 企业把学生可同地参与，当作学校声誉的替代、补充，还是两者都不是？
new_angle: 把学校端门槛条件转为企业如何组合声誉与同地空间，避免越入院系边界。

label: EXP-039
text_en: When one classroom project underperforms, does a firm revise its overall perceived value downward more quickly than it revises it upward after a successful project?
text_cn: 当一个课堂项目表现不佳时，企业下调整体价值感知的速度，是否会比成功项目后上调更快？
new_angle: 把价值感知与实际价值的落差转为感知更新的不对称性，而非只问如何统一。

label: EXP-040
text_en: When a school tries to reconcile a firm's perceived value with its actual value, which value items are necessarily unobservable from project outputs and therefore remain outside any shared record?
text_cn: 当学校试图调和企业的价值感知与实际价值时，哪些价值项无法从项目产出中观测到，因而注定无法进入任何共享记录？
new_angle: 把“统一价值”问题转为价值项可观测性边界；共享账本方案已拆入 `扩题_设计题.md` DES-004。

label: EXP-041
text_en: Does firm-side efficiency loss occur mainly before, during, or after the student team's active collaboration?
text_cn: 企业端效率损失主要发生在学生团队正式协作之前、期间还是之后？
new_angle: 把效率损失从三类活动延展到项目全生命周期，不再并进交接/退出摩擦的分离问题。

label: EXP-042
text_en: If efficiency is independent of incentive, does a highly motivated but operationally inefficient firm leave a distinctive pattern in the school's own records—such as repeated schedule changes, deadline slippage, or delayed access requests?
text_cn: 如果效率确实独立于 incentive，一个积极性高但运营效率低的企业，会不会在学校自己的记录里留下可辨识的模式，比如反复改期、截止日滑移或访问权限迟迟不批？
new_angle: 把“效率独立于 incentive”落成学校可自查的投诉与请求记录模式。

label: EXP-043
text_en: When a firm reports efficiency loss in university collaboration, is that loss concentrated in coordination across organizational boundaries, or in the firm's own internal preparation?
text_cn: 企业报告校企合作中的效率损失，集中在跨组织协调，还是企业内部准备环节？
new_angle: 去掉“学校加专职对接人”的干预，改为定位企业端效率损失发生在跨组织协调还是内部准备。

label: EXP-044
text_en: Is the most truthful signal of long-term collaboration intent different for a first-time firm than for a returning firm?
text_cn: 企业长期合作意愿最真实的信号，对首次合作企业和续约企业是否不同？
new_angle: 把信号真实性从全样本排序改为按企业合作阶段条件化，不再附带申请数权重设计。

label: EXP-045
text_en: Does a firm's mentor assignment signal long-term intent more strongly when the mentor is named in a written commitment before the course begins than when the name appears only after students are matched?
text_cn: 企业若在开课前以书面承诺预先指定导师，是否比学生配对完成后才给出导师名字更能体现长期合作意愿？
new_angle: 把“导师投入”信号拆成事前承诺与事后补名的时点差异。

label: EXP-046
text_en: Does the signal value of a firm's earliest pre-course action—naming a mentor, requesting student data, or proposing a multi-cycle project—differ between first contact and the renewal decision, so that the same action means something different at the two moments?
text_cn: 企业最早的课前动作——指定导师、索取学生数据，还是提议跨周期项目——所传递的信号价值，在首次接触时和续约决定时是否不同；同一个动作在两个时点是否含义不一样？
new_angle: 把长期意愿信号从单点判别改为同一动作在首次接触/续约两个时点的意义变化，避开 EXP-045 的导师时点；原方案题已移入 `扩题_设计题.md` DES-001。

label: EXP-047
text_en: Does the truthfulness of a firm's long-term-intent signal change when the school can compare the firm's applications or mentor commitments across peer schools, rather than seeing only its own records?
text_cn: 当学校能对照同一家企业在其他同类学校的申请或导师承诺，而不只看到本校记录时，企业长期意愿信号的真实性会改变吗？
new_angle: 把信号真实性放入跨校比较条件，区别于 EXP-009 的单校排序；原方案题已移入 `扩题_设计题.md` DES-002。

label: EXP-048
text_en: Do different firm functions give the school different accounts of participation value—HR emphasizing a talent pipeline, R&D emphasizing solution input, and marketing emphasizing brand visibility?
text_cn: 企业不同部门给学校的参与价值说法是否不同——HR 强调人才储备、研发强调方案输入、市场强调品牌曝光？
new_angle: 把“谁归因”从对接人/导师二选一扩展为跨职能叙事差异，不再追问叙事差异是否预示续约纠纷。

label: EXP-049
text_en: Can a school detect whether a firm's renewal rationale is forward-looking or retrospectively constructed by comparing its pre-course stated goals with its post-course success claims?
text_cn: 学校能否通过对比企业开课前声明的目标与结课后声称的成效，判断其续约理由是前瞻规划还是事后建构？
new_angle: 把“事前/事后”从定性判断变成可操作的目标—成效对照，不再追问哪种错位属于事后合理化。

label: EXP-050
text_en: Is a firm more likely to defend the value of participation ex post when its realized value takes longer to appear?
text_cn: 企业实现参与价值所需时间越长，是否越倾向于事后为参与价值辩护？
new_angle: 把事后归因与价值兑现时滞连接起来，不再追问价值说法是否更偏对外表达。

label: EXP-051
text_en: Which component of the firm's university-collaboration transaction cost is most fixed across project sizes—search, contracting, mentoring, monitoring, or exit—thereby making small student projects disproportionately expensive?
text_cn: 企业一次校企合作的交易成本中，哪个部分最不随项目规模变化——搜寻、签约、带教、监督还是退出——从而让小型学生项目承担不成比例的高成本？
new_angle: 把交易成本从总量/低估问题改成固定成本结构带来的规模不经济。

label: EXP-052
text_en: Between a firm's first and second year of participation, does its cost mix shift from search and contracting toward mentoring and exit?
text_cn: 企业参与第一年到第二年之间，成本结构是否会从搜寻和签约转向带教和退出？
new_angle: 把交易成本构成静态分解转为跨年结构迁移，不再追问哪种迁移代表成熟或衰退。

label: EXP-053
text_en: Does a firm's search cost differ when selection is performed by the firm rather than by the school's pre-screening process?
text_cn: 企业自行筛选，与由学校前置筛选相比，企业的搜寻成本会不同吗？
new_angle: 把成本转嫁从学生间分布改为企业与学校之间两种筛选主体下的搜寻成本比较，不再预设筛选工作已经转移。

label: EXP-054
text_en: Are monitoring costs higher when firm projects require proprietary systems, security clearance, or on-site lab access than when students use school infrastructure?
text_cn: 当企业项目需要专有系统、安全许可或到企业现场使用实验室时，监督成本是否高于学生使用校内基础设施的情况？
new_angle: 把监督成本落到技术/空间权限约束，不再追问成本差异是否形成准入门槛。

label: EXP-055
text_en: Does the direction of multi-school marginal cost depend on whether partner schools share the same semester calendar and grading regime, so that re-matching rather than re-templating determines the cost?
text_cn: 企业对接多所学校的边际成本方向，是否取决于这些学校是否采用相同的学期日历和评分制度——即成本由重新匹配而非重新模板化决定？
new_angle: 把多校成本方向的决定变量从课程模板/关系资产改为校际日历与制度一致性。

label: EXP-056
text_en: When one firm runs multiple student teams across schools, do marginal costs fall with team count but rise with team heterogeneity?
text_cn: 同一家企业在多所学校运行多个学生团队时，边际成本是否会随团队数量下降、又随团队异质性上升？
new_angle: 把规模经济与异质性成本拆成两个反向效应，不再追问拐点位置。

label: EXP-057
text_en: If multi-school costs decrease through templating, does the firm shift toward low-adaptation projects and reserve its custom projects for the schools with the best data access or brand fit, thereby concentrating educational value at favored schools?
text_cn: 如果模板化让多校成本下降，企业是否会转向低定制化项目，而把定制项目留给数据访问权限或品牌匹配最好的学校，从而让教育价值集中在少数受偏爱的学校？
new_angle: 把多校规模经济引入教育价值分配的非对称后果。

label: EXP-058
text_en: Does a firm measure its post-participation outcomes at all?
text_cn: 企业到底有没有测量自己参与后的成效？
new_angle: 把问题前置到“测不测”本身，而非只问哪些指标变化或学校能否观察。

label: EXP-059
text_en: Which firm metric changes fastest after participation—recruiting cost, new-hire quality, innovation output, or internal technical solutions?
text_cn: 企业参与后，哪个指标变化最快——招聘成本、新员工质量、创新产出还是内部技术方案？
new_angle: 把“哪些指标变化”转为变化速度，不再追问学校的最小观察窗口。

label: EXP-060
text_en: Is a firm more willing to report post-participation metrics when the results look favorable, creating an imbalance in which outcomes a school can ever learn about?
text_cn: 企业是否在结果看起来有利时更愿意报告参与后的指标？这种选择性报告，会不会造成一种结构性失衡，使学校永远只能了解到部分结果？
new_angle: 把指标测量问题转为报告偏误与学校可见性失衡。

label: EXP-061
text_en: When a firm attributes its year-2 exit to value being crowded out rather than absent, do the three crowding-out sources — budget cuts, staffing changes, or liaison turnover — carry different probabilities and timings of the firm returning?
text_cn: 当企业把第二年退出归因于“价值被挤出”而非“没有价值”时，预算削减、人事变动、对接人更换这三类挤出原因，是否分别对应企业回归的不同概率和时点？
new_angle: 种子题与 EXP-014 都停在“没价值 vs 被挤掉”，本题进一步区分三种挤出来源，不再追问学校如何管理挽回路径。

label: EXP-062
text_en: When the original liaison departs but a different team from the same firm later re-approaches the school, does the firm–school relationship survive the project-level turnover, or does the relationship value leave with the individual?
text_cn: 当原对接人离开、但同一家企业的另一个团队之后再来接触学校时，校企关系能否在项目级人员变动后继续存活，还是说关系价值会随个人一起离开？
new_angle: 种子题问“第二年不来的原因”，本题换到同一家企业内部团队重新上门的场景，区分项目级退出与校企级关系存续。

label: EXP-063
text_en: When a firm publicly reports “no value” on exit, does that attribution remain stable under an anonymous exit questionnaire, or does named reporting bias the firm toward face-saving explanations and conceal a budget- or staffing-related crowding-out cause?
text_cn: 当企业退出时公开说“没有价值”，这种归因在匿名退出问卷下是否仍然成立？还是具名汇报会让企业更倾向给出“没有价值”这类保面子的解释，从而掩盖预算或人事挤出的真实原因？
new_angle: 种子题问“怎么区分”，本题把测量工具本身当作变量，检验具名或匿名是否改变归因。

label: EXP-064
text_en: Is the 2–3-year delay in realized firm value uniform across value types, or do talent-pipeline value, cost-saving value, and innovation value each follow a distinct time-to-value profile?
text_cn: 企业价值要 2–3 年才兑现，这一时滞对所有价值类型都一样吗？人才管道价值、成本节约价值、创新价值是否各自遵循不同的兑现时间曲线？
new_angle: 种子题问时滞是否可复制、如何随企业类型变化，本题把“价值”拆成三种类型并比较其时间曲线。

label: EXP-065
text_en: Is Jason’s “2–3 years” measured in calendar time or in accumulated exposure — student contact hours, project iterations, or mentor sessions?
text_cn: Jason 所说的“2–3 年”，是按日历时间计算，还是按累计接触量——学生接触小时、项目迭代次数或导师辅导次数——计算？
new_angle: 种子题把时滞当作时间结构，本题质疑其计量单位是日历时间还是接触量。

label: EXP-066
text_en: Does the 2–3-year delay in realized firm value reflect the student team's loss of continuity, the firm's loss of accumulated memory, or both?
text_cn: 企业价值要 2–3 年才兑现，这一时滞反映的是学生团队的连续性丧失、企业自身积累记忆的丧失，还是两者兼有？
new_angle: 种子题与 EXP-015 都从“项目连续性”解释时滞，本题进一步区分项目连续性与企业记忆两个机制；跨届产物移交方案已拆入 `扩题_设计题.md` DES-005。

label: EXP-067
text_en: Can renewing and nonrenewing firms be distinguished by observable pre-renewal behavior, such as requesting student work samples or sending senior reviewers?
text_cn: 续约企业与非续约企业，能否通过续约前可观察行为区分，例如索取学生作品样本或派资深评审参与？
new_angle: 把配对比较从学校行政记录转到企业可观察行为，保持企业方边界。

label: EXP-068
text_en: Do renewing firms report value differently from firms that drop out when both are asked the same question, or does the difference only appear in who chooses to answer?
text_cn: 续约企业和退出企业，在被问到同样问题时报告的价值不同，还是差异只在于谁选择回答？
new_angle: 把幸存者偏差从学校统计口径转到企业报告与回答选择行为。

label: EXP-069
text_en: Would a firm state its expected value from a student project before the renewal decision differently from what it states after renewal?
text_cn: 企业在续约决定前陈述的项目预期价值，与续约后陈述的价值是否不同？
new_angle: 把预注册面板换成企业自身的续约前后陈述差异，保持企业方边界。

label: EXP-070
text_en: Does a firm's reported value from a student project rise or fall between the first-year window and the 2–3-year window, depending on whether it stays or exits?
text_cn: 企业对学生项目报告的价值，在第 1 年与第 2–3 年窗口之间是上升还是下降，是否取决于它留下还是退出？
new_angle: 把幸存者偏差的方向问题落到企业报告价值的窗口变化，避免学校侧方法题。

label: EXP-071
text_en: Does the year-1 versus years-2–3 exit distinction hold for the same firm across repeated engagement cycles, or does a firm that exits in year 1 for expectation mismatch carry that unresolved mismatch into later cycles?
text_cn: “第 1 年流失”与“第 2–3 年流失”的区分，对同一家企业跨多个合作周期是否依然成立？还是说因预期不匹配而在第 1 年退出的企业，会把未解决的错配带到后续周期？
new_angle: 种子题横向比较第 1 年与第 2–3 年流失原因，本题改为同一企业跨周期的纵向检验。

label: EXP-072
text_en: Does the school’s classification of an exit as year-1 expectation mismatch versus years-2–3 non-materialization depend on which firm informant answers — mentor, HR liaison, or budget owner?
text_cn: 学校把一次退出标为“第 1 年预期不匹配”还是“第 2–3 年价值未兑现”，会不会取决于回答者是谁——导师、HR 对接人还是预算负责人？
new_angle: 种子题问两个年段的流失原因是否相同，本题转而追问原因分类是否受受访者身份影响，不再追问谁被当作权威。

label: EXP-073
text_en: In year-1 expectation mismatch, is the mismatch about student capability or about project scope?
text_cn: 在第 1 年的预期不匹配中，错配的是学生能力还是项目范围？
new_angle: 种子题把第 1 年概括为“预期不匹配”，本题拆分错配对象，不再追问退出记录是否误导课程设计。

label: EXP-074
text_en: Is a firm’s need for a long or short observation cycle better explained by its business clock — product cycle, sales cycle, or hiring cycle — than by coarse labels such as firm size or sector?
text_cn: 企业需要长观察周期还是短观察周期，用企业规模或行业这类粗略标签来解释更合适，还是用它的业务时钟——产品周期、销售周期或招聘周期——来解释更合适？
new_angle: 种子题用“企业类型”解释长短周期，本题提出业务时钟作为替代分类变量，并检验其解释力。

label: EXP-075
text_en: When a long-cycle firm is placed in a short-cycle course, does it extend observation beyond the course boundary by re-contacting students later?
text_cn: 当需要长周期的企业被放进短周期课程时，它会不会在课程边界之外继续观察学生，并在之后再联系他们？
new_angle: 种子题问企业适合长/短周期，本题改问周期错配时企业把观察延伸到课程外。

label: EXP-076
text_en: Is part of the observed mismatch between firm type and course timescale explained by measurement error in classifying a firm's business clock?
text_cn: 企业类型与课程时间尺度之间已观察到的错配，是否有部分来自对企业业务时钟进行分类时的测量误差？
new_angle: 种子题问稳定匹配是否存在，本题把错配部分归因于分类误差，不再预设学校构建分类工具。

label: EXP-077
text_en: After controlling for a firm's business clock (product, sales, and hiring cycles), does its need for a long or short student-observation window still change with its life-cycle stage?
text_cn: 在控制企业业务时钟（产品周期、销售周期、招聘周期）之后，企业对长/短学生观察窗口的需求，是否仍会随生命周期阶段改变？
new_angle: 在业务时钟解释之后单独检验生命周期阶段，避免与 EXP-074 重复。

label: EXP-078
text_en: If willingness to keep investing is inverse-U shaped, does the peak occur earlier for firms with higher student throughput because they can form a reliable judgment about students faster?
text_cn: 如果继续投入意愿呈倒 U 形，对学生吞吐量更高的企业，峰值是否会来得更早？因为它们能更快地对学生形成可靠判断。
new_angle: 种子题问倒 U 是否存在、EXP-018 问能否察觉拐点，本题追问拐点位置如何随学生吞吐量前移。

label: EXP-079
text_en: Is the post-peak decline in a firm’s willingness driven by having already extracted all student signal, or by project maintenance cost rising while new learning falls?
text_cn: 企业投入意愿在峰值之后的下降，是因为它已经提取完了所有学生信号，还是因为项目维护成本上升、新增学习却在下降？
new_angle: 种子题只问形状是倒 U 还是单调递减，本题拆解峰值后下降的机制。

label: EXP-080
text_en: Can a school test inverse-U versus monotonic decline using only renewal decisions and mentor-hour records, without access to the firm’s internal return-on-investment?
text_cn: 学校能否只凭续约决定和导师投入小时记录，在没有企业内部投资回报数据的情况下，检验“倒 U 形”还是“单调递减”？
new_angle: 种子题问“刚刚好的点是否真实存在”，本题把它转成学校在有限数据下的可检验性，不再追问哪种记录模式具有决定性。

label: EXP-081
text_en: When the actual collaborator is an individual, can the school tell whether a renewal promise reflects that person's personal incentive or a formally authorized firm commitment?
text_cn: 当实际合作者是一个具体的人时，学校能否分辨一个续约承诺反映的是这个人的个人激励，还是经过正式授权的企业承诺？
new_angle: 把“个人 vs 企业 incentive”落到续约承诺的授权可观测性，而非团队预算或范围控制。

label: EXP-082
text_en: When the individual champion inside a firm leaves and a successor inherits the partnership, does the collaboration retain the firm's original incentive or silently shift to the successor's personal incentive?
text_cn: 当企业内部的个人推动者离职、继任者接手合作时，这段合作保留的是企业原有的激励，还是会悄悄换成继任者的个人激励？
new_angle: 关注个人推动者离职后的激励继承，不再追问学校在哪个交接节点察觉。

label: EXP-083
text_en: When an HR liaison and a technical mentor disagree about project scope, does the school see the conflict only through which data or meeting requests get blocked?
text_cn: HR 对接人与技术导师在项目范围上意见不一致时，学校是否只能通过哪些数据或会议请求被卡住来察觉冲突？
new_angle: 把个人激励分歧从预算/范围控制转为学校可观察的请求受阻模式，不再追问能否反推主导激励。

label: EXP-084
text_en: Does the class-2 label mark a project as non-core before it reaches students?
text_cn: class-2 这个标签是不是在项目到达学生之前，就已经把它标成了非核心？
new_angle: 关注 class-2 标签到达学生前的降级属性，而非交出的时间点和决策人。

label: EXP-085
text_en: After a class-2 project is handed to students, what would lead the firm to take it back in-house instead of sending another student team next cycle?
text_cn: class-2 项目交给学生之后，企业会因为什么而把它收回内部，而不是下一轮继续交给另一支学生团队？
new_angle: 从“交出决策”转向“收回/重启决策”，不再追问两种决策角色是否不同。

label: EXP-086
text_en: When a firm moves a class-2 project to students, does the handoff transfer only task execution or also decision rights?
text_cn: 企业把一个 class-2 项目交给学生时，移交的只是任务执行，还是也包括决策权？
new_angle: 问移交的是决策权还是仅任务执行，区别于交出的时间边界与谁分诊。

label: EXP-087
text_en: For a long-term sponsor that almost never hires, can the school distinguish a stable CSR or network motive from an unfulfilled recruiting attempt?
text_cn: 对一家长期赞助却几乎不招人的企业，学校能否分辨它是在稳定地经营 CSR 或关系网络，还是一次从未兑现的招聘尝试？
new_angle: 把“买的到底是什么”细化为稳定动机 vs 未兑现招聘，不再追问哪种续约行为能区分。

label: EXP-088
text_en: If a long-term sponsor values staff development, does that value accrue through employees mentoring students or through employees observing student projects?
text_cn: 如果长期赞助方看重员工发展，这份价值是通过员工带教学生获得，还是通过员工观摩学生项目获得？
new_angle: 把“员工发展必须靠导师角色”改为两条可区分的员工发展通道，不再追问学校能否从记录区分。

label: EXP-089
text_en: When a sponsor pays for years without hiring, does its renewal depend more on the school producing a stable student pipeline or on the firm's internal program budget surviving leadership changes?
text_cn: 当一家赞助方多年付费却不招人，它的续约更取决于学校能否稳定提供学生来源，还是取决于企业内部的项目预算能否在领导层更替中存活下来？
new_angle: 把长期不招人赞助的续约问题拆成学校供给与企业预算存活两个依赖。

label: EXP-090
text_en: Which school-generated artifact—student demos, mentor names, or alumni-network contacts—best discriminates a stable CSR or network motive from an unfulfilled recruiting attempt in a long-term non-hiring sponsor?
text_cn: 对长期付费却不招人的赞助方，学生演示、导师名单、校友网络联系人这三类学校生成的产物中，哪一种最能区分它是在稳定经营 CSR/关系网络，还是一次从未兑现的招聘尝试？
new_angle: 把长期动机推断改为三类学校生成物的判别力问题，作为 EXP-087 的测量工具。

label: EXP-091
text_en: Does an SME resolve the try-before-you-buy tension by compressing the trial into shorter sprints?
text_cn: 中小企业是否会通过把试用压缩成更短的迭代周期，来化解“先试后买”的张力？
new_angle: 引入缩短迭代周期作为中小企业的化解方式，不再追问筛选精度。

label: EXP-092
text_en: For an SME that cannot wait, can its discount rate be read from the contract terms it requests—conversion deadline, exclusivity, or payment timing—rather than from what it says about talent needs?
text_cn: 对一家等不起的中小企业，它的贴现率能不能从它要求的合同条款——转正截止时间、排他性、付费时点——中读出来，而不是从它嘴上说的人才需求中判断？
new_angle: 把中小企业的高贴现率操作化为合同条款，而非泛泛谈张力。

label: EXP-093
text_en: Between an SME and a large firm running the same student project, does the large firm's longer waiting horizon shift value from immediate hire conversion to a later talent pipeline?
text_cn: 在同一个学生项目上，中小企业与大企业的差异，是否表现为大企业更长的等待视野把价值从“即时转正”转向“更晚的人才管道”？
new_angle: 对比同一项目上大企业与中小企业的价值时点差异，不再追问学校如何设置续约预期。

label: EXP-094
text_en: If temporal mismatch explains attrition, is the decisive unit the liaison's tenure or the budget year?
text_cn: 如果时间错配能解释流失，起决定作用的是对接人任期，还是预算年度？
new_angle: 把时间错配拆成对接人任期 vs 预算年度，不再追问学校如何检验预测。

label: EXP-095
text_en: When a firm's liaison leaves midway through a student-training cycle, does the collaboration restart only when the successor is new to the school, but continue when the successor is an alumnus or a former mentor?
text_cn: 企业对接人在学生培养周期中途离职时，合作是否只在继任者对学校陌生时才重新计时，而继任者是校友或前导师时就能延续？
new_angle: 把“对接人离职重启时钟”加入继任者与学校的既有关系这一调节条件。

label: EXP-096
text_en: For a firm whose budget year never aligns with the student cohort cycle, is the mismatch driven more by the start month, the cohort length, or the renewal window?
text_cn: 对一家预算年度与学生周期始终对不齐的企业，这种错配更多由开学月份、培养周期长度，还是续约窗口驱动？
new_angle: 从解释错配转向错配来源的结构分解；重新同步干预方案已拆入 `扩题_设计题.md` DES-006。

label: EXP-097
text_en: For a firm whose budget cycle and student cycle never align, does attrition still unfold as a series of forced year-zero resets even when the firm's stated incentive remains strong?
text_cn: 对一家预算周期与学生周期始终对不齐的企业，即使企业明示的激励仍然很强，流失是否仍会表现为一连串被迫的“零年重启”？
new_angle: 提出“零年重启”的流失体验，检验强激励是否仍会被时间断点打断。

label: EXP-098
text_en: Under a budget cut, does an alumnus liaison's personal alma mater sentiment delay the firm's exit?
text_cn: 在预算削减时，校友对接人的个人母校情结会不会推迟企业退出？
new_angle: 关注预算冲击下校友情结是否推迟退出，不再追问学校如何判断韧性或延迟退出。

label: EXP-099
text_en: When an alumnus serves as liaison, is the collaboration more fragile at every role transition, or can the alumnus convert personal sentiment into an organizational succession plan that outlives them?
text_cn: 当校友担任对接人时，合作是不是每逢岗位更替都更脆弱；还是说，校友能把个人情结转成一套组织层面的交接方案，让合作在自己离开后仍能延续？
new_angle: 把脆弱/稳固问题转化为是否有组织化交接机制。

label: EXP-100
text_en: Does an alumnus liaison's dual identity distort the school's access to early-warning information, because the alumnus softens negative firm signals to protect the relationship?
text_cn: 校友对接人的双重身份，会不会扭曲学校获取预警信息的通道，因为校友会为了维护关系而淡化企业的负面信号？
new_angle: 把校友双重身份落到学校预警信息通道的扭曲。

label: EXP-001
text_en: Does the annual cycle of national teaching funding create a cash-flow gap between when an instructor must commit to a firm and when the school can release funds?
text_cn: 国家教学经费一年一次拨付，会不会造成“老师先向企业承诺、学校后到账”的现金流缺口？
new_angle: 把“学校没钱”从存量缺口落到拨款时点与承诺时点之间的现金缺口。

label: EXP-002
text_en: When a school has only one annual funding source, does that single source make enterprise-engaged course budgets more sensitive to a one-year funding cut than to a decline in firm demand?
text_cn: 学校只有单一年度经费来源时，校企合作课程预算对“某一年拨款被砍”是否比对“企业需求下降”更敏感？
new_angle: 把没钱问题从存量缺口转为单一来源下对两类冲击的敏感性比较。

label: EXP-003
text_en: Is the institution's shortage of money better measured by the absence of a dedicated firm-engagement budget line than by the total amount of teaching funding it receives?
text_cn: 衡量学校“没钱”，看它没有专门的校企合作预算科目，是否比看教学经费总额更准？
new_angle: 从总经费多少转到预算科目是否单独列支这一结构信号。

label: EXP-004
text_en: Does the once-a-year funding calendar push firm-engagement decisions into a fixed window, so that schools cannot respond to a firm's off-cycle decision to enter or leave?
text_cn: 一年一次的经费日历，是否把校企合作决策逼进固定窗口，导致学校无法响应企业在非窗口期做出的进出决定？
new_angle: 从资金量转到资金时间窗口对学校响应灵活性的约束。

label: EXP-005
text_en: Does an institution's decision to keep supporting a firm-engaged course respond more to reputational upside or to downside risk?
text_cn: 学校决定是否继续支持一门校企合作课程时，更多是对声誉上行空间做出反应，还是对声誉下行风险做出反应？
new_angle: 把学校 incentive 从“声誉/风险”并称拆成上行与下行两个方向，检验哪个更占主导。

label: EXP-006
text_en: Does an institution's reputational incentive allocate more discretionary funding to a star course or to a marquee firm?
text_cn: 学校的声誉激励，会把更多可自由支配经费投向一门明星课程，还是一家明星企业？
new_angle: 把声誉激励落到可支配经费在课程与企业之间的分配，而非只问声誉是否存在。

label: EXP-007
text_en: What observable record would reveal whether an institution treats firm engagement primarily as reputation management rather than as educational provision: promotion dossiers, course approval documents, or public prospectuses?
text_cn: 哪些可观察记录能揭示学校把校企合作主要当作声誉管理、而非教育供给：晋升档案、课程审批文件，还是公开招生材料？
new_angle: 把学校 incentive 从抽象动机转成三类可观察记录中的判断依据。

label: EXP-008
text_en: Is the institution's risk motive more visible in which firms it declines than in which firms it recruits?
text_cn: 学校的风险动机，在它拒绝哪些企业时是否比在它招募哪些企业时更容易看出来？
new_angle: 把风险偏好从“是否愿意合作”转到进入/退出决策两侧的可观察差异。

label: EXP-009
text_en: For an ordinary university, does a firm's willingness to enter depend more on the school absorbing the firm's transaction costs than on the school offering a lower-cost student pipeline?
text_cn: 对普通高校而言，企业是否愿意进入，更多取决于学校承担企业的交易成本，还是学校提供更低成本的学生来源？
new_angle: 把“普通校怎么对接企业”拆成学校承担成本与低成本学生供给两个替代条件。

label: EXP-010
text_en: Does an ordinary university's first contact with a firm come through an individual instructor's personal network more often than through an institutional employer-relations office?
text_cn: 普通高校与企业的首次接触，更多通过某位教师的个人网络，还是通过学校层面的雇主关系办公室？
new_angle: 把普通校对接企业落到首次接触的组织通道，而非只问“能否对接”。

label: EXP-011
text_en: When an ordinary university cannot run a star course, is a firm's uncertainty about partner quality driven more by team size, pilot length, or cost-sharing?
text_cn: 当普通高校开不出明星课时，企业对合作质量的顾虑，更多来自学生团队规模、试点周期，还是成本分担？
new_angle: 把“强校明星课”的替代条件具体化为团队规模、试点周期、成本分担三个影响企业顾虑的来源，不再预设学校采取干预。

label: EXP-012
text_en: Is an ordinary university's ability to attract long-term firms constrained more by its absence of a marquee course than by its absence of a central firm-relations office?
text_cn: 普通高校吸引长期合作企业的能力，更多受制于没有明星课程，还是受制于没有校级企业关系办公室？
new_angle: 把“普通校差在哪”拆成课程招牌与组织能力两个约束并比较。

label: EXP-013
text_en: When rules exist but no one manages firm attrition, is the missing governance located at the instructor, department, or school level?
text_cn: 当制度存在、却没人管理企业流失时，缺失的治理究竟位于教师、学系还是学校层？
new_angle: 把“锁定在合规层”拆成治理缺口所在的组织层级。

label: EXP-014
text_en: Does the compliance layer persist because moving to governance would create a new budget obligation that no single unit owns?
text_cn: 合规层之所以持续存在，是否因为转向治理会制造一笔没有任何单一单位愿意认领的新预算义务？
new_angle: 把“不敢从合规到治理”落到新治理预算无人认领这一成本机制；与 INS-09 EXP-029 互引。

label: EXP-015
text_en: Is the absence of governance observable in whether firm attrition appears in any school-level performance report?
text_cn: 治理缺失是否可以从“企业流失有没有出现在任何校级绩效报告中”观察到？
new_angle: 把“有制度无治理”从抽象判断转成企业流失是否进入校级报告这一可观察标准。

label: EXP-016
text_en: Does the institution's compliance-layer lock depend more on a fixed accreditation requirement or on the absence of a staff role accountable for firm retention?
text_cn: 学校锁定在合规层，更多取决于固定的认证要求，还是取决于没有一个专责企业留存的岗位？
new_angle: 把合规层锁定拆成认证制度与责任岗位两个来源；与 INS-09 EXP-032 互引。

label: EXP-017
text_en: Across HKU, CUHK, HKUST, and PolyU, does firm attrition vary more with whether firm engagement is credit-bearing than with whether a central office manages employer relations?
text_cn: 在港大、港中大、港科大、港理工四校，企业流失更多随“校企参与是否计学分”变化，还是随“是否有校级办公室管理雇主关系”变化？
new_angle: 把四校治理差异落到“是否计学分”与“是否中央化”两个可比较制度变量。

label: EXP-018
text_en: In the four schools, is the shift from compliance to governance associated with a change in who owns the firm relationship—an instructor, a department, or a central office—rather than with the amount of funding?
text_cn: 四校从合规走向治理，是否更多伴随着企业关系归属在教师、学系或校级办公室之间转移，而非资金量变化？
new_angle: 把四校差异从资金多寡转到企业关系归属这一组织变量。

label: EXP-019
text_en: Do the four schools' governance differences become visible earlier in how they record firm exits than in how they recruit firms?
text_cn: 四校治理差异，是否在“如何记录企业退出”上比在“如何招募企业”上更早显现？
new_angle: 把治理差异放到企业退出记录这一先兆指标，而非只比较招募端。

label: EXP-020
text_en: Which governance difference best separates PolyU's mandatory 80-hour model from HKU's zero-credit model: monitoring intensity, credit-bearing design, or renewal responsibility?
text_cn: 最能区分港理工强制 80 小时模式与港大零学分模式的治理差异是什么：监督强度、是否计学分，还是续约责任？
new_angle: 把四校比较聚焦到港理工与港大两个极端模式的关键制度变量。

label: EXP-021
text_en: When school, student, instructor, and firm disagree about whether a collaboration succeeded, which yardstick is most likely to be recorded in official course evaluations?
text_cn: 当学校、学生、教师和企业对合作是否成功意见不一致时，哪一方的标准最可能被写进官方课程评估？
new_angle: 把“成功谁说了算”落到官方评估中最可能记录哪一方的标准。

label: EXP-022
text_en: Does the school's success measure (completion or credit) systematically ignore the firm's success measure (hire conversion or project output), or are the two measures weakly correlated?
text_cn: 学校以完成或学分衡量成功，是否系统性地忽略了企业以转正或项目产出衡量的成功；还是说这两个衡量标准只是弱相关？
new_angle: 把多元成功标准拆成“系统性忽略”与“弱相关”两个可检验关系。

label: EXP-023
text_en: When an instructor declares a course successful but the firm does not return, does the school treat the instructor's account or the firm's non-return as the more authoritative signal?
text_cn: 当教师宣称课程成功、企业却不续约时，学校会把教师的说法还是企业的退出当作更权威的信号？
new_angle: 把成功归属冲突转成学校在两种信号之间的权威排序。

label: EXP-024
text_en: Is the disagreement over success larger between the school and the firm than between the student and the firm?
text_cn: 关于成功标准的意见分歧，学校与企业之间是否大于学生与企业之间？
new_angle: 把多方分歧从“是否存在”转为不同利益方对之间分歧大小的比较。

label: EXP-025
text_en: After a one-off successful course, is the firm's non-return better predicted by the absence of a standing course slot than by dissatisfaction with that year's student team?
text_cn: 一次性成功课程之后，企业不再回来，更可能因为学校没有固定课程时段，还是因为对当年学生团队不满意？
new_angle: 把一次性成功后的不复来拆成课程时段与当年团队两个竞争解释。

label: EXP-026
text_en: Does a one-off course produce an institutional memory of how to re-run it, or does that memory remain with the individual instructor?
text_cn: 一次性课程会沉淀出学校层面“如何重开这门课”的记忆，还是这套记忆只留在教师个人身上？
new_angle: 把一次性课程能否复制落到组织记忆归属，而非只问企业回不回来。

label: EXP-027
text_en: When an instructor must scramble half a year in advance for every one-off course, does that preparation time fall disproportionately on course design rather than on firm recruitment?
text_cn: 教师每学期都要提前半年为一次性课程四处张罗时，这部分准备时间是否不成比例地花在课程设计上，而非企业招募上？
new_angle: 把“教师提前半年折腾”拆成课程设计与企业招募两类时间投入。

label: EXP-028
text_en: Does the conversion of a one-off course into a recurring one depend more on whether the firm commitment is written into the course catalogue than on the instructor's personal relationship with the firm?
text_cn: 一次性课程能否转为持续课程，更多取决于企业承诺是否写进课程目录，还是教师与企业的个人关系？
new_angle: 把“明年企业还回不回来”落到正式课程目录与个人关系两个机制；与 INS-30 EXP-046 互引。

label: EXP-029
text_en: What does the institution risk losing first if it moves a firm-engaged course from compliance to governance: accreditation alignment, instructor autonomy, or budget control?
text_cn: 学校把校企合作课程从合规推向治理时，最先可能失去的是什么：认证要求、教师自主权，还是预算控制？
new_angle: 把“为什么不敢从合规走到治理”拆成三类最先暴露的损失；与 INS-05 EXP-014 互引。

label: EXP-030
text_en: Does the institution avoid governance because no single office can claim the credit for improved firm retention, while compliance failures can be assigned to someone?
text_cn: 学校回避治理，是否因为提升企业留存后没有单一部门能认领功劳，而合规失败却总能被追责到人？
new_angle: 把“卡住的是什么”转成治理收益无人认领与合规失败有人担责的激励不对称。

label: EXP-031
text_en: Is the perceived risk of moving to governance higher for the school's administrative staff than for the instructors who already manage firms informally?
text_cn: 对学校行政人员而言，转向治理的感知风险，是否高于那些已经非正式管理企业的教师？
new_angle: 把“院系不敢动”拆成行政人员与一线教师对风险的不同感知。

label: EXP-032
text_en: Does the block lie in the absence of a decision rule for when a firm should be re-engaged, rather than in the absence of staff capacity?
text_cn: 真正卡住治理的，是缺少“何时重新接洽企业”的决策规则，还是缺少人手？
new_angle: 把治理障碍拆成决策规则缺失与人力容量缺失两个竞争解释；与 INS-05 EXP-016 互引。

label: EXP-033
text_en: In an enterprise-engaged course where the bill is footed by a third party, is the value created by the firm, the student, or the school the one most likely to be under-recorded?
text_cn: 在由第三方买单的校企合作课程里，企业、学生或学校各自创造的价值中，哪一方最容易被低估？
new_angle: 把“羊毛出在猪身上”从价值归属问题转为三方价值中哪一方最被低估。

label: EXP-034
text_en: Does the third-party payer fund the most visible output rather than the output that creates the most long-term value?
text_cn: 第三方买单者资助的是最显眼的产出，还是最能创造长期价值的产出？
new_angle: 把价值 capture 与 creation 分离落到付费方资助的产出类型。

label: EXP-035
text_en: When value creation and value capture are separated, does the party that captures value lose the incentive to maintain the relationship after the course ends?
text_cn: 当价值创造与价值获取分离时，获取价值的一方是否失去在课程结束后维护关系的激励？
new_angle: 把“谁有 incentive 维护价值”落到价值获取方在课程结束后的行为；与 INS-30 EXP-045 衔接（维护关系 vs 最大化价值本身）。

label: EXP-036
text_en: Is the wool-from-the-pig's-back arrangement more likely to under-provision relationship maintenance, student mentorship, or outcome measurement?
text_cn: “羊毛出在猪身上”的安排，更可能导致哪一项供给不足：关系维护、学生带教，还是成果测量？
new_angle: 把第三方买单的后果落到三类具体投入的供给不足；与 INS-30 EXP-048 衔接（哪项不足 vs 谁先察觉）。

label: EXP-037
text_en: Among the school, firm, and student, is the party with the lowest outside option also the party that bears the largest unrecorded cost in a firm-engaged course?
text_cn: 在学校、企业和学生中，外部选择最差的一方，是否也就是承担最大未记录成本的一方？
new_angle: 把“谁最离不开”与“谁多承担成本”放进同一比较关系。

label: EXP-038
text_en: Does the school's low elasticity come from having no alternative firm for a required course, while the firm's low elasticity comes from needing a specific student pipeline?
text_cn: 学校的低弹性是否来自必修课没有替代企业，而企业的低弹性来自需要特定学生来源？
new_angle: 把双方“离不开”分别落到各自缺少替代条件的具体来源。

label: EXP-039
text_en: When the school is least able to walk away, does it concede more on project scope, grading authority, or student selection?
text_cn: 当学校最不能退出时，它在项目范围、评分权或学生选择上，哪一项会做出更多让步？
new_angle: 把“低弹性多承担成本”落到三类具体可让渡权利。

label: EXP-040
text_en: Is the economic incidence of firm-engagement costs visible in which party absorbs last-minute schedule changes—the school, the firm, or the student?
text_cn: 校企合作成本的经济归宿，是否可以从“谁承担临时改期”看出来：学校、企业还是学生？
new_angle: 把弹性/税负归宿落到临时改期由谁承担这一可观察行为。

label: EXP-041
text_en: Which part of enterprise-engaged course management is least automated today: planning, matching, monitoring, or enhancement?
text_cn: 校企合作课程管理中，今天最没有被自动化的是哪一部分：规划、匹配、监控还是改进？
new_angle: 把“工具化”问题拆成课程管理四环节的自动化缺口。

label: EXP-042
text_en: Does automation shift the institution's role from managing individual firm relationships to managing the data that represents those relationships?
text_cn: 自动化是否让学校的角色从管理单个企业关系，转向管理代表这些关系的数据？
new_angle: 把工具化落到学校职能从关系管理到数据管理的转变。

label: EXP-043
text_en: When planning, management, and enhancement are automated, does the manual work move to exception handling rather than disappear?
text_cn: 当规划、管理和改进被自动化后，人工工作是否会转移到异常处理，而不是真正消失？
new_angle: 把自动化收益从“减少人工”修正为“人工转移到例外处理”。

label: EXP-044
text_en: Is the absence of instrumentation better explained by the lack of a shared data model for firm engagement than by the cost of software?
text_cn: 工具化缺失，更多是因为缺少校企合作的共享数据模型，还是因为软件成本太高？
new_angle: 把“怎么自动化”拆成数据模型缺失与软件成本两个障碍。

label: EXP-045
text_en: When value creation and value capture are separated, who, if anyone, has the incentive to maximize the value itself rather than capture it?
text_cn: 价值创造与价值获取分离时，谁还有激励去最大化价值本身，而不是获取价值？
new_angle: 把“关系质量 vs 产出质量”的细化改为“谁最大化价值本身”的主体问题，避免与 INS-19 EXP-035 重复。

label: EXP-046
text_en: Is one-off-ness the economic root of low relationship-specific investment, because no party internalizes the full return from a recurring course?
text_cn: “一次性”是否就是关系专用投资不足的经济根源，因为没有一方能把持续课程的全部回报内部化？
new_angle: 把一次性现象直接连到关系专用投资不足的经济机制；与 INS-08 EXP-028 互引。

label: EXP-047
text_en: Does the third-party payer's funding rule reward the number of firm engagements more than the duration of those engagements?
text_cn: 第三方买单者的资助规则，是否更奖励校企合作的数量，而不是合作的持续时间？
new_angle: 把羊毛出在猪身上的激励来源落到资助规则对数量与持续时间的不同奖励。

label: EXP-048
text_en: When a third-party-funded arrangement under-provisions value, who notices first: the firm, the student, or the funder?
text_cn: 第三方买单安排导致价值供给不足时，谁最先察觉：企业、学生，还是买单方？
new_angle: 把“哪项产出不足”的清单改为“谁最先察觉不足”，避免与 INS-19 EXP-036 产出清单重叠。

label: EXP-001
text_en: Which mechanism most directly links promotion credit to firm-engagement work: teaching-load credit, service credit, or research output?
text_cn: 哪一种机制最直接把职称激励接到校企合作工作上：教学工作量认定、公共服务认定，还是科研产出？
new_angle: 把“评职称如何接入机制设计”落到三类可计分通道，而不是只问要不要激励。

label: EXP-002
text_en: When promotion criteria omit enterprise-in-the-classroom, does instructor effort shift toward activities that are counted?
text_cn: 当职称评审不把“企业进课堂”算进去时，教师的精力会不会转向那些被计入职称的活动？
new_angle: 把评职称激励的缺口转成教师精力在“被计分/未被计分”活动之间的再分配；与 TCH-08 EXP-013 互引。

label: EXP-003
text_en: Is the promotion incentive more effective when it changes who can claim credit—individual instructor or department—than when it increases the reward size?
text_cn: 职称激励更有效，是在它改变“谁能认领功劳”（教师个人还是学系）时，还是在它单纯提高奖励力度时？
new_angle: 把评职称激励的有效性拆成“功劳归属变化”与“奖励力度变化”两个通道。

label: EXP-004
text_en: Does promotion-driven course design produce durable firm relationships, visible course features, both, or neither?
text_cn: 职称驱动的课程设计，带来的是更持久的企业关系、更显眼的课程表面特征、两者兼有，还是两者都没有？
new_angle: 把评职称接入机制设计后的结果拆成“持久关系”与“表面可见性”两种产出，并保留两者兼有/都没有的退路；与 TCH-08 EXP-014 互引。

label: EXP-005
text_en: Who bears the cost of external experts when a PBL course exceeds one instructor's capacity: the department, the course budget, or the firm?
text_cn: 当 PBL 课程超出单个教师承受范围时，外请专家的成本由谁承担：学系、课程预算，还是企业？
new_angle: 把“额外老师工资谁出”从一句话扩展为学系、课程预算、企业三个承担主体。

label: EXP-006
text_en: Does the funding source for external experts predict whether they take on teaching or only project mentoring?
text_cn: 外请专家的经费来源，是否决定了他们承担的是教学，还是只做项目指导？
new_angle: 把外请专家成本与专家职责范围连接起来，而不只问钱从哪来。

label: EXP-007
text_en: When the instructor cannot pay external experts, does the course substitute fewer experts, larger student teams, or less authentic projects?
text_cn: 当教师付不起外请专家费用时，课程会用更少专家、更大团队，还是更不真实的项目来替代？
new_angle: 把“外请专家工资谁出”转成资金约束下课程会做出的三类替代。

label: EXP-008
text_en: Is the cost of external experts visible in course workload accounting, or does it remain an invisible in-kind contribution?
text_cn: 外请专家的成本，会出现在课程工作量核算里，还是始终是一项看不见的实物贡献？
new_angle: 把“谁出钱”落到成本是否进入正式核算这一可观察边界。

label: EXP-009
text_en: When firm attrition is not formally assigned to anyone, does the instructor still feel accountable for it through student outcomes, course evaluations, or peer reputation?
text_cn: 企业流失没有正式责任归属时，教师是否仍通过学生结果、课程评估或同事声誉感受到问责？
new_angle: 把“责任在哪一层”的治理问题改为教师端的问责感知，避免与 INS-05 EXP-013 重复。

label: EXP-010
text_en: When a firm leaves, does the school attribute the loss to the instructor's teaching, the firm's budget, or the course design?
text_cn: 企业退出时，学校会把损失归因于教师教学、企业预算，还是课程设计？
new_angle: 把“谁对留存负责”落到学校在企业退出时的三类归因。

label: EXP-011
text_en: Is instructor accountability for retention higher when the course is credit-bearing than when it is extracurricular?
text_cn: 课程计学分时，教师对企业留存的问责，是否高于课外活动形式的校企合作？
new_angle: 把教师留存责任放到计学分与课外活动两种制度条件下比较。

label: EXP-012
text_en: Does making the instructor accountable for retention shift effort toward firm maintenance and away from student learning, or do the two move together?
text_cn: 让教师对企业留存负责，是否会把精力从学生学习转向企业维护；还是说这两者会一起增减？
new_angle: 把“老师要不要担责任”的后果落到教师精力在企业维护与学生学习之间的分配。

label: EXP-013
text_en: When promotion review does not count enterprise-in-the-classroom, does instructor participation depend more on personal relationships with firms than on institutional reward?
text_cn: 当职称评审不认“企业进课堂”时，教师参与校企合作更多靠与企业的个人关系，还是靠学校激励？
new_angle: 把“评职称不认”的后果落到教师参与依靠个人关系还是制度激励；与 TCH-02 EXP-002 互引。

label: EXP-014
text_en: What keeps an instructor going after promotion recognition is absent: student outcomes, external reputation, or firm-provided resources?
text_cn: 当职称激励不存在时，是什么让教师继续做下去：学生成长、外部声誉，还是企业提供的资源？
new_angle: 把“老师靠什么撑下去”拆成三类非职称动力来源；与 TCH-02 EXP-004 互引。

label: EXP-015
text_en: Does the absence of promotion recognition make instructor-led firm engagement more fragile when the instructor's personal network changes?
text_cn: 当职称不认可企业进课堂时，教师主导的校企合作是否会在教师个人网络变化时变得更脆弱？
new_angle: 把“没有职称激励”的脆弱性放到教师个人网络变动这一时点检验。

label: EXP-016
text_en: Can the school observe whether an instructor continues firm engagement for promotion credit or for teaching improvement by comparing pre- and post-tenure activity?
text_cn: 学校能否通过比较教师获得职称前后的校企活动，判断其继续参与是为了职称积分，还是为了教学改进？
new_angle: 把“职称认不认”转成教师获职称前后活动差异的可检验问题。

label: EXP-017
text_en: Compared with a 2–3 week summer PBL, does a semester-long PBL produce more firm-relevant output, more student exposure, or both?
text_cn: 与 2–3 周暑期 PBL 相比，学期制 PBL 产出的是更多企业可用成果、更多学生接触，还是两者兼有？
new_angle: 把长/短周期比较落到“企业可用产出”与“学生接触量”两个不同结果，并保留两者兼有。

label: EXP-018
text_en: When a course switches between long-cycle and short-cycle firms, does the instructor lose more accumulated teaching material, firm-specific routines, or student-facing pacing?
text_cn: 课程在长周期与短周期企业之间切换时，教师损失更多的是已积累教学材料、企业专属流程，还是学生节奏？
new_angle: 把“哪类企业适合长周期”的企业侧问法改为教师切换周期类型的成本。

label: EXP-019
text_en: Is the instructor's cost of switching cycle types higher when the new firm observes students at a different point in the course than when only total contact hours change?
text_cn: 当新企业对学生的观察时点改变时，教师切换周期类型的成本，是否比只改变总接触时长更高？
new_angle: 把长/短周期匹配转到教师切换成本，并区分观察时点与总时长两个变化来源。

label: EXP-020
text_en: When a course moves from semester to summer format, does the instructor lose more time for firm recruitment or for student mentoring?
text_cn: 当课程从学期制改为暑期制时，教师会更多损失企业招募时间，还是学生指导时间？
new_angle: 把周期切换的代价落到教师两类时间投入的损失比较。

label: EXP-021
text_en: Does the progression from no-threshold to domain-specific topics match the point at which students acquire calculus or statistics?
text_cn: 从无门槛课题到领域专属课题的进阶，是否正好对应学生学会微积分或统计的时间点？
new_angle: 把分年级课题序列与前置知识习得时间点对齐，而不只按年级标签；与 TCH-15 EXP-025/026 互引。

label: EXP-022
